sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a little girl holding a kite on a string. Draw this exact girl as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: her torso in the blue polka-dot swimsuit with its ruffled frill at the hips, as in image 1, with her bare shoulders and neck, without head, without arms and without legs: no arms and no hands drawn on it, no legs below the frill; the top of the neck, normally under the head, rounded.
2. the head: her head with the yellow sun hat, its red ribbon and bow, her brown hair with its two bunches and little red hair ties, and her ears, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; its bottom edge, at the chin and the neck, rounded.
3. the kite arm: her arm on the left of image 1, drawn whole from the top of the shoulder down to the hand, bent at the elbow with the hand raised beside her as in image 1, the hand a loose fist (with no string in it); its top the full, smooth, rounded curve of the shoulder.
4. the same arm hanging down straight and relaxed beside her, with its open hand; its top the same rounded shoulder.
5. the free arm: her arm on the right of image 1, drawn whole from the top of the shoulder down to the open hand, hanging relaxed as in image 1; its top the full, smooth, rounded curve of the shoulder.
6. the same free arm raised up high, bent a little at the elbow, the open hand up with its fingers spread, waving; its rounded shoulder at the bottom.
7. the same free arm held out straight, the hand pointing with its index finger; its rounded shoulder at one end.
8. her left leg (on the left of image 1), drawn whole from the top of the thigh, normally hidden under the frill, down to the bare foot, as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded curve.
9. her right leg (on the right of image 1), drawn whole from the top of the thigh down to the bare foot, as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded curve.
10. the kite on its string: the colourful diamond kite with its ribbon tail of three little bows and its thin string running down from the kite, all as in image 1, just the kite, its tail and its string, no hand.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a little girl holding a kite; image 2 shows the same girl cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the girl's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the girl in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the girl's right eye (on the left of image 1): a big dark round eye with a white sparkle and its little lashes, as it is in image 1.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle, a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim.
6. the same eye crying: gently squeezed shut, a soft downward-curving line (a sad closed eye, not a smile), a few small lashes, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer end.
7. her eyebrow as it is in image 1: a thin brown arched line.
8. the same eyebrow sad: tilted up at its inner end.
9. her small nose as it is in image 1.
10. her mouth as it is in image 1: a happy closed smile.
11. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
12. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
13. the mouth in a small sad frown.
14. the mouth sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside, trembling.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
